scripts.dev: npm run db:setup && nodemon --exec "ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register" src/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects unit --passWithNoTests && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects integration --runInBand --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects unit --coverage && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--experimental-vm-modules jest --selectProjects integration --runInBand
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: for s in gridcheck assigncheck timercheck overhaulcheck publishcheck; do echo "--- $s"; npx ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register scripts/$s.ts | tail -1 || exit 1; done
scripts.db:setup: npx prisma migrate deploy --config prisma/prisma.config.ts && npx prisma generate --config prisma/prisma.config.ts
